  444 #===============================================================================
  445 # OnStatLoss handlers
  446 #===============================================================================
  447 Battle::ItemEffects::OnStatLoss.add(:EJECTPACK,
  448   proc { |item, battler, move_user, battle|
  449     next false if battler.effects[PBEffects::SkyDrop] >= 0 ||
  450                   battler.inTwoTurnAttack?("TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableInSkyTargetCannotAct")   # Sky Drop
  451     next false if battle.pbAllFainted?(battler.idxOpposingSide)
  452     next false if battler.wild?   # Wild Pokémon can't eject
  453     next false if !battle.pbCanSwitchOut?(battler.index)   # Battler can't switch out
  454     next false if !battle.pbCanChooseNonActive?(battler.index)   # No Pokémon can switch in
  455     battle.pbCommonAnimation("UseItem", battler)
  456     battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is switched out by the {2}!", battler.pbThis, battler.itemName))
  457     battler.pbConsumeItem(true, false)
  458     if battle.endOfRound   # Just switch out
  459       battle.scene.pbRecall(battler.index) if !battler.fainted?
  460       battler.pbAbilitiesOnSwitchOut   # Inc. primordial weather check
  461       next true
  462     end
  463     newPkmn = battle.pbGetReplacementPokemonIndex(battler.index)   # Owner chooses
  464     next false if newPkmn < 0   # Shouldn't ever do this
  465     battle.pbRecallAndReplace(battler.index, newPkmn)
  466     battle.pbClearChoice(battler.index)   # Replacement Pokémon does nothing this round
  467     battle.moldBreaker = false if move_user && battler.index == move_user.index
  468     battle.pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(battler.index)
  469     next true
  470   }
  471 )

  516 Battle::ItemEffects::StatusCure.add(:LUMBERRY,
  517   proc { |item, battler, battle, forced|
  518     next false if !forced && !battler.canConsumeBerry?
  519     next false if battler.status == :NONE &&
  520                   battler.effects[PBEffects::Confusion] == 0
  521     itemName = GameData::Item.get(item).name
  522     PBDebug.log("[Item triggered] #{battler.pbThis}'s #{itemName}") if forced
  523     battle.pbCommonAnimation("EatBerry", battler) if !forced
  524     oldStatus = battler.status
  525     oldConfusion = (battler.effects[PBEffects::Confusion] > 0)
  526     battler.pbCureStatus(forced)
  527     battler.pbCureConfusion
  528     if forced
  529       battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} snapped out of its confusion.", battler.pbThis)) if oldConfusion
  530     else
  531       case oldStatus
  532       when :SLEEP
  533         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} woke it up!", battler.pbThis, itemName))
  534       when :POISON
  535         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} cured its poisoning!", battler.pbThis, itemName))
  536       when :BURN
  537         battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} healed its burn!", battler.pbThis, itemName))
  538       when :PARALYSIS

  540       when :FROZEN

  543       if oldConfusion
